Should the attorney have requested a deposit and the deposit have not been paid, the attorney may elect to
cease any work on the matter until such time as I/we have paid the deposit.
The deposit will be paid into the following bank account:
The attorney is entitled to charge fees on the attorney and own client scale for services
rendered in terms hereof and that I/we undertake and agree to pay the attorney fees as set out
in this agreement.  I/we understand that there is a difference between party & party costs and
attorney & own client costs and, if I/we am successful, I/we will be entitled to recover from the
other party the attorney and client and relevant costs as per agreement and/or court order costs
but will still be liable for payment of the attorney & own client costs.
The fees on an attorney and own client scale will be calculated on a time basis in terms
of an agreed hourly tariff, which fee rates are attached hereto marked Annexure “A”.
For time spent on a matter, each hour will be divided into 4 units (1 unit = 15 minutes or part
The fees in respect of the time reasonably spent by the attorney will be calculated at an hourly
tariff as indicated on Annexure “A” (VAT excluded), unless specifically otherwise agreed.  The
hourly rate will automatically escalate at 15 % per annum.

I/we hereby authorise the attorney to receive any monies which may be payable to me/us, and to recover
their fees and disbursements owing by me/us, before any balance is paid out to me/us.
The attorney will keep all information obtained from me/us, which is not in the public domain, confidential,
and will only otherwise disclose it with my/our authority or if required to do so by the laws and professional
regulations applicable to them. Nevertheless, I/we agree that the attorney may disclose any relevant
information in order to protect and/or defend themselves in any actual or threatened legal, civil or
regulatory proceeding and may also disclose any relevant information in confidence to their insurers,
insurance brokers, auditors and other advisers.
I/we will provide the attorney and will instruct my/our other advisers and any professional associates or
other co-participants to provide the attorneys, on any services on which they are instructed, with all
relevant information and documents, all of which will have been properly obtained and on which the
attorney may rely without verification. I/we agree that, unless I/we instruct the attorney otherwise, they may
disclose any relevant information to my/our other professional advisers.
I/we agree that the attorney is under no duty to disclose to me/us or use on my/our
behalf any information in respect of which the attorney owes a duty of confidentiality to
another client or any other person.
I/we agree that the attorney may disclose their role as legal advisers in any services on
which they are instructed following its completion, for the purposes of publicity, unless
I/we instruct them otherwise. I/we also agree that, unless I/we instruct them otherwise,
the attorney may publicise the fact that they have a relationship with me/us.

as required by law or during the proper performance of its duties.

provide my/our voluntary and informed consent to the transfer of my/our personal information by
the attorney outside of South Africa.

event of my/our failing to pay any fees or disbursements in terms of this agreement and/or fail to provide
them with instructions.  In this event the attorney shall be entitled to exercise his/her retention right and
therefore be entitled to retain all documentation in his/her possession, whether prepared by him/her or not,
until the full amount outstanding in respect of fees and disbursements together with interest is paid.
I/we reserve to myself the right to withdraw from this undertaking and to terminate the mandate given in
terms hereof by giving the attorney 7 (SEVEN) days written notice of such withdrawal and termination.
I/we accept that the attorney, in the event of such withdrawal, will be entitled to payment of the fees and
